# awx_job_template_associate_credential (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (Number) Database ID of the credential to assign.
- `job_template_id` (Number) Database ID for this JobTemplate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <job_template_id>/<credential_id>
import {
  to = awx_job_template_associate_credential.example
  id = "1/2"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <job_template_id>/<credential_id>
terraform import awx_job_template_associate_credential.example 1/2
```
